summary: Tested BRSR Organization Details feature (backend + frontend). All 9 backend pytest tests pass (GET/PUT/validate/auth/persistence/validation errors). Frontend e2e flow works end-to-end: login as esg-test-user@example.com -> /organization page -> BRSR collapsible section visible (because BRSR enabled) -> Edit Details opens edit mode -> all BRSR data-testid inputs editable -> 4 Add Row buttons present and functional -> Save BRSR Details triggers PUT and shows 'BRSR details saved successfully' toast -> Complete badge displayed after full save. One non-blocking React warning detected (setState during render in BRSRDetailsSection).

issues: Native <select> elements used with VE dev wrappers cause hydration warnings ('span cannot be a child of select/option'). Likely a dev-tool artifact but worth verifying in production build.

action_items: Fix React 'Cannot update a component (OrganizationDetails) while rendering a different component (BRSRDetailsSection)' warning: in BRSRDetailsSection.js handlers (lines ~155-194), `onDataChange(updated)` is called *inside* the `setFormData` updater function, which triggers the parent setBRSRData during render. Move the onDataChange call out of the updater (e.g., call it after setFormData using the new value, or use a useEffect that watches formData) to avoid the setState-in-render anti-pattern.

Optional: ensure the initial empty-state UX shows 'Incomplete' badge with a clear empty missing_fields list (currently when no BRSR doc exists, backend returns missing_fields=[] which is misleading - it should probably enumerate the required fields).
critical_code_review_comments: BRSRDetailsSection.js: `onDataChange(updated)` invoked inside setFormData updater function (handleInputChange/handleTableRowChange/addTableRow/removeTableRow) is a React setState-in-render anti-pattern. React logs a warning at runtime; can cause stale data or double-renders.

Backend service.py `validate_brsr_complete`: returns missing_fields=['No BRSR details found'] when no doc exists which is a non-field token; frontend renders it as a missing field label. Consider returning the actual mandatory field list for new orgs.

Frontend OrganizationDetails.js uses native <select> elements for country/state instead of shadcn Select used elsewhere (BRSR section), causing inconsistency and the hydration nesting warning observed in console.
BRSRDetailsSection.js file is ~988 lines and could benefit from extraction of the 4 dynamic-table sub-components for maintainability (DRY: table-row rendering pattern repeats 4x).
seed_data_creation: BRSR details document persisted in organization_framework_details for org 5df41e27-c90d-4660-90b5-475823e0b55f via PUT tests (TEST_ prefixed data: listed_entity_name='TEST_BRSR Entity Ltd' / 'TEST Frontend Entity'). No teardown performed - data remains for visual verification.

Frontend BRSRDetailsSection.js renders, persists, and shows Complete badge after full save. The minor setState-in-render warning is non-blocking but should be fixed for code quality. Saved record for org 5df41e27-c90d-4660-90b5-475823e0b55f contains TEST_ data - can be safely overwritten by next run.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature works as designed. The setState-in-render React warning RCA: In BRSRDetailsSection.js, the four mutation handlers call `if (onDataChange) onDataChange(updated)` inside the updater function passed to setFormData. React executes that updater during render, so calling the parent's setBRSRData() at that time schedules a setState on another component mid-render. Fix: compute the new value, then call setFormData(newValue) followed by onDataChange?.(newValue) outside the updater, or use a useEffect listening to [formData] that calls onDataChange.
